description: Role-based skill bundles for selective context loading. Activate only the bundle(s) relevant to the current task to preserve context window budget.

core-dev.description: Full-stack development — backend, schema, types, state, validation
core-dev.use_when: Building or auditing backend services, APIs, Firestore schemas, or type systems

security.description: Zero-trust security, auth, penetration testing, and compliance
security.use_when: Security audits, Firebase rules authoring, IAM review, penetration testing

ui.description: Frontend, Liquid Glass aesthetic, dark mode, FOUC prevention
ui.use_when: UI component development, design audits, visual regression, FOUC debugging

testing.description: E2E and integration testing with Playwright
testing.use_when: Writing, debugging, or running E2E or integration test suites

ops.description: Deployment, performance, email, CLI, and infrastructure operations
ops.use_when: Deployments, performance audits, CI/CD, email infrastructure, terminal operations

mobile.description: iOS and Android native bridge via Capacitor
mobile.use_when: Mobile app build, native bridge integration, deep linking, push notifications

research.use_when: Pre-task knowledge gathering, architectural planning, skill improvement, documentation

ai.description: AI/ML engineering, Vertex AI, Gemini, ADK tooling
ai.use_when: AI feature development, Vertex AI integration, ADK tool scaffolding, LLM output structuring
